review.explanation: The mention '温' is an abbreviated surname reference. The main text opens with '温嶠初爲劉琨使' establishing 温嶠 as the protagonist, and the subsequent '温新至深有諸慮' and '温忠慨深烈' clearly refer back to this same person. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-99f58dc85ade2998d334) shows the surface '温' in the source. The coreference with the full-name mention sfh1-mention-f9c56eefb0e8ad55a8376127 is well-supported by the narrative context. No contradicting evidence exists.

The mention '温公' is an honorific reference to Wen Qiao (温嶠). The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-02-yanyu-036-liu-annotation-002) explicitly uses '温公始入' in the context of the same story about 温嶠 visiting 王丞相. The annotation text continues with '温公旣見丞相' (annotation-003), confirming this is the same person as the 温嶠 in the main text. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-add41b0bba0399d09c3a) shows '温公' in the alias registry context. No contradicting evidence.

The mention '王丞相' refers to the Chancellor (丞相). The main text states '旣詣王丞相' and '丞相亦與之對泣', establishing 王丞相 as the person Wen Qiao visits. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-02-yanyu-036-liu-annotation-003) also uses '王丞相' in the same narrative context. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-766b8b08247533c5b51a) shows '王丞相' as an office title alias for 王導. While the semantic record returned 'uncertain' with low confidence, the main text and annotation both consistently use 王丞相/丞相 for the same individual in this story, and the alias registry maps this office title to 王導. The hard veto against c1 (温嶠) is correct since 王丞相 is clearly distinct from 温嶠 in the narrative.

The mention '劉琨' is a direct canonical name reference. The main text states '温嶠初爲劉琨使', clearly identifying 劉琨 as the person who sent 温嶠 as envoy. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-89afe0ccb6701cef3dfb) shows '劉琨' from people.json as a canonical name. The reference semantics correctly identifies this as distinct from 温嶠 and the Chancellor. No contradicting evidence exists.

The mention 丞相 appears in the main text immediately following 王丞相, referring to the same person. The candidate evidence from aliases.json confirms 王導 (Wang Dao) is identified with the office title 丞相. The main text shows 温嶠 visiting 王丞相, and then 丞相 appears repeatedly as the same referent. The Liu annotation also uses 王丞相 and 丞相 interchangeably for the same figure. The office title match is consistent and no contradicting evidence exists.

The main text describes 温嶠 as the envoy of 劉琨 coming to Jiangdong, which is historically consistent with Wen Qiao's role. The name match is exact and unambiguous. 潁上人 is a descriptive reference indicating that Guan Zhong was a person from Yingshang. It describes the same person as 管仲夷吾, serving as an appositive descriptor of his origin.

晉王 is a ruler title referring to the Jin prince (Sima Rui, later Emperor Yuan of Jin). It appears in the Liu annotation context about 温奉使勸進晉王. It is distinct from 管仲夷吾 and 齊桓公 who are historical figures from the Spring and Autumn period.
晉王君臣 is a collective reference to the Jin prince and his ministers/officials. It includes 晉王 as part of the group. It is distinct from 賓客 (guests) who are a separate group in the annotation context.

管仲 is the abbreviated form of Guan Zhong's name, coreferent with 管仲夷吾 (sfh1-mention-d4a5257679415bd6e151d3d8) and 管夷吾 (sfh1-mention-fb00951dabdf8f1a9850fb8c). In the annotation, 温公 is compared to 管仲 (seeing 温公 is like seeing 管仲).
劉琨 is the person for whom 温嶠 serves as envoy; distinct from 温嶠 and the Chancellor.
賓客 refers to the assembled guests who saw 温公 (Wen Qiao) enter. They are a collective group distinct from 晉王君臣 and from 温公 himself.

管仲夷吾 is the full name of Guan Zhong (管仲), styled Yiwu (夷吾). He is the same person as 管仲 (sfh1-mention-8cd8ab54007459d3147314c6) and 管夷吾 (sfh1-mention-fb00951dabdf8f1a9850fb8c). He served as minister to Duke Huan of Qi (齊桓公). 潁上人 describes his origin, not a distinct person.
齊桓公 is Duke Huan of Qi, the ruler whom Guan Zhong served as minister. He is distinct from Guan Zhong and from 晉王.
丞相 is the abbreviated office title referring to the same person as 王丞相 earlier in the text, i.e., Wang Dao.
温嶠 is the protagonist, full name form. He is the envoy of 劉琨 and visits 王丞相.

管夷吾 is the full name of Guan Zhong (管仲), the famous Spring and Autumn period minister. In the main text, 温嶠 says '江左自有管夷吾' (the Jiangzuo region naturally has its own Guan Yiwu), referring to 王丞相 (Wang Dao) as a modern-day equivalent of Guan Zhong. The mention 管夷吾 in the main text corefers with 管仲夷吾 and 管仲 in the Liu annotations. It is distinct from all contemporary figures in the story. The comparison relation is between 温嶠's implied referent (王丞相) and 管夷吾, though the surface comparison is made by 温嶠's speech.
